commit: fix(compiler-sfc): don't hoist props and emit

truth.description: compileScript now removes a destructured defineProps declaration only when the propsDestructure option is passed, but processPropsDestructure also turns destructure on for reactivityTransform, the only one of the two that the SFC playground passes, so there the declaration is neither removed nor rewritten to __props and the compiled setup still calls defineProps and fails at runtime.

distractions.why: processWithDefaults replaces the inner defineProps call recorded by processDefineProps with the whole withDefaults call, so the later rewrite to __props also drops the defaults object instead of leaving a withDefaults call behind.
